phase3_findings.description: devflow.yml header comment (line 3-4) said 'comment/review' implying review-event triggers still fire; corrected to 'comment' with an issue-#1163 note.

AC #8's framing of a with.ref pin as a prohibited wording-only pin is imprecise; such a pin could be a legitimate security-credential-boundary structural pin. Reviewer rated 3/10 and did NOT recommend adding it.

fix_decisions.claim_text: a with.ref structural pin should be added
fix_decisions.evidence: AC #8 deliberately decided no new test with a stated reason; the trust property is already gated by the (d)/(d+) subscription assertions, and a dropped/weakened ref pin is behaviorally inert under the sole issue_comment trigger (GITHUB_REF already resolves to the default branch). Adding the pin would contradict the issue's explicit AC #8 decision; the reviewer rated it 3/10 and did not recommend it.

parking_evidence.basis: the coverage gap is doubly-conditional and its primary control (the subscription set) is already pinned; AC #8 explicitly decided no new test
parking_evidence.failing_input: a future edit dropping a ref pin while also re-subscribing (the adversarial class scoped to #1300)
